description: Simplified generated raster illustration of crossed AK and M4 rifles, both in matching ivory, framed by an ochre laurel wreath on graphite. Only the AK color was changed from the preceding accepted composition. Not a photograph or extracted game asset.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied ArenaMode emblem. Make ONE color change only: recolor the entire ochre AK rifle to exactly the same warm ivory/off-white color family as the existing M4 rifle (#eceae3 for its lit surfaces, matching dark graphite shadows and muted grey-beige midtones).
The AK is the rifle running from the fixed stock at the lower left to the barrel at the upper right, including its visible receiver, fore-end, front sight, barrel, pistol grip and curved magazine below the center. Recolor all those AK parts consistently; no gold/ochre should remain on the AK.
Preserve the accepted image otherwise as precisely as possible: identical firearm geometry and level of detail, same positions and scale, same crossing/occlusion, same M4 colors, same laurel leaves and stems in ochre #bfa15d, same dark graphite background, framing, margins and lighting. Do not recolor the laurel wreath. Do not add anything or change the composition. Both rifles should now share the same ivory treatment and stand apart from the ochre laurel. Retain opaque background and square format.
processing: Only downscaling to 1024, 128 and 64 px and exporting opaque RGB sRGB PNGs; master copied byte-for-byte.

previousGenerations.description: Simplified generated raster illustration of crossed AK and M4 rifles framed by a laurel wreath, in graphite, ivory and ochre. Based on the previous realistic thumbnail; not a photograph or extracted game asset.
previousGenerations.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Edit target: the supplied ArenaMode thumbnail with crossed realistic AK and M4.
Primary request: make this specific composition noticeably more schematic and restrained, using the established graphite, warm ivory and muted ochre visual identity, and add a simple laurel wreath as an arena/victory symbol.
Keep: exactly one recognizable AK and one recognizable M4 in the same crossed X arrangement, muzzles at upper corners, stocks at lower corners; M4 crossing in front of AK. Preserve convincing real firearm proportions and distinctive shapes, including the AK curved magazine and fixed stock and the M4 carry handle and adjustable stock.
Change style: simplify the existing photographic forms into a subdued duotone poster illustration / softly modeled emblem. Remove fine scratches, screws, woodgrain, bright metallic sheen and tiny mechanical details. Keep only a few large shadow planes and restrained shape-defining highlights. The result should sit between a realistic inventory illustration and a silhouette. Do not revert to the previous crude geometric rifle pictograms.
Palette: plain solid graphite background #171b1c. Main M4 form in warm ivory #eceae3, AK in muted ochre #bfa15d, with graphite shadows. No brown or orange wood color, no silver metal, no extra saturated colors. Flat matte tonal treatment, no glossy gold.
Wreath: two balanced elegant laurel branches in muted ochre #bfa15d, framing the rifles from below and along both sides, open at the top. About 8 broad simple leaves per branch, clean shapes with no interior leaf veins. Branch stems meet subtly at bottom center. Keep a clear graphite gap between wreath leaves and the rifle silhouettes, no clutter or crossing through the main weapon shapes. The wreath should be secondary to the guns and recall a restrained arena champion emblem.
Layout: square, centered, generous consistent outer margin around complete guns and wreath. Wreath stays fully visible. If needed scale the crossed rifles down modestly so the wreath frames them naturally. Maintain strong legibility at 64 x 64 pixels.
No text, numbers, logo, badge shield, stars, ribbon, border, sparks, smoke, flames, background texture, gradient, vignette or dramatic lighting. Produce a finished raster illustration, not an SVG.

previousGenerations.description: Photorealistic generated illustration of crossed AK and M4 rifles for the ArenaMode thumbnail. Not a photograph or extracted game asset.
previousGenerations.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: square 1024 x 1024 thumbnail for the ArenaMode game mod.
Edit target: image 1 is the current ArenaMode thumbnail. Replace its two flat vector rifle silhouettes with detailed, convincingly photorealistic depictions of exactly one classic AKM/AK-47 rifle and one M4A1 carbine, laid across one another in the same clear X composition. Image 2 is an AK reference for credible side-profile shape, proportions, wood and metal details.
Composition: AK butt at lower left and muzzle at upper right; M4 butt at lower right and muzzle at upper left. Both entire weapons fully visible with about 12 percent outer margin. Full lateral side profiles, gently raised from the backdrop like clean photographic cutouts. The M4 lies in front of the AK at their single central crossing. Preserve continuous, physically coherent rifles with unambiguous separate barrels, stocks, magazines and grips. No impossible fused parts.
Subject: classic AK with worn muted warm walnut fixed stock and fore-end, dark steel receiver and pronounced curved steel magazine. Authentic classic M4A1 with dark grey metal receiver, black polymer adjustable stock, ribbed carbine handguard, carry handle, correct triangular front sight and standard thirty-round magazine. No scopes, suppressors, straps or unnecessary attachments.
Style: restrained studio product photograph / extremely realistic game inventory render, not a drawing or vector. Crisp but natural materials, believable restrained wear. Light the dark metal sufficiently brightly for readability at 64 pixels, with soft ivory highlights and muted wood warmth that fits the original ochre accent.
Background: retain an entirely plain, uniform opaque graphite background #171b1c, no gradient or scenery. No glow, sparks, smoke, vignette, texture on the background, border, badges, letters, logo, text or watermark.
Do not reproduce the original abstract silhouette geometry. The two actual recognizable firearm forms are the whole image.
previousGenerations.processing: Only downscaling to 1024, 128 and 64 px and exporting opaque RGB sRGB PNGs; master copied byte-for-byte.
